newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says privatisation plan to continue.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says privatisation plan to continue.

text.p: South Korea said on Thursday it would continue to privatise state-run companies by selling their stakes and introducing professional managers.
Finance minister Kang Kyong-shik said in a news conference that hiring professional managers in state companies would help the government's privatisation programmes, not delay them.
The government plan to employ such managers in state firms has been viewed by some quarters as a ploy to shelve the privatisation schemes.
Last year, the government said it would delay privatisation of four big state-run companies, including Korea Gas Corp and Korea Telecom Corp, due to a slump in the stock market.
